usageNotes: Use this to enumerate the top-level configuration sub-resources exposed by the PDM API; it acts as a directory index rather than returning configuration values directly. The response is a list of available sub-endpoints under /config, not a settings payload. No special privilege beyond a valid API token is required.
tips: The return type is null in the spec, meaning the useful data is in the array of child links — iterate those to discover which /config/* endpoints are available on your PDM version.
Because this endpoint requires no parameters and is read-only, it is safe to call during health checks or capability probing.
